name: Afamelanotide
description: Synthetic 13-amino-acid peptide built like alpha-MSH, the body's own skin-pigment signal

note.text: Scenesse is the only afamelanotide product found with FDA approval. Melanotan peptides sold for tanning are not FDA approved.

bullets: **Binds mainly the MC1 receptor,** per the label
**Raises eumelanin,** the brown-black pigment, without sun or UV light
**In EPP,** more pigment cuts light reaching protoporphyrin IX (EMA)
US trial: 64.1 vs 40.5 pain-free sun hours
EMA: added time in sunlight was small

notEstablished.text: PK in liver or kidney disease

practical.routes: Implant under the skin above the hip bone
practical.pharmacokinetics: Median peak at 36 hours; may undergo hydrolysis
practical.soldAs: Prescription implant (Scenesse), placed by a professional
practical.monitored: Full body skin exam twice a year

references: Langendonk et al., N Engl J Med, afamelanotide in EPP, Jul 2015
